About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced AI Generative Video Specialist to join our freelance roster and create high-end generative video for commercial and branded content.
You’ll work with our producers and creative team to turn briefs, storyboards, and visual references into polished, production-ready AI video.

What You’ll Do

Generate high-quality video and imagery using Seedance 2.5 and other leading generative AI models
Translate creative direction and references into effective prompts and generation strategies
Maintain consistency across characters, environments, products, lighting, and overall visual style
Rapidly iterate, troubleshoot difficult shots, and identify the best approach to achieve the desired result
Stay current on emerging generative models and workflows

What We’re Looking For

Professional experience creating high-quality generative AI video
Strong working knowledge of Seedance 2.5 and other current video/image models
Strong visual instincts for cinematography, composition, lighting, movement, and realism
Ability to take creative direction and independently own AI execution from concept through finished shots
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to iterate quickly
Portfolio or reel demonstrating high-end generative video work required

Bonus Skills

AI-assisted upscaling, cleanup, restoration, denoising, rotoscoping, or masking
AI-assisted VFX, compositing, color, or relighting workflows
Experience integrating AI-generated material into traditional post-production pipelines
Scripting or automation experience for AI and post-production workflows

Pay: $50.00 - $70.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
